beats.say: Every hour, without me, this agent runs a health check on my entire business.
It opens every page, checks the store and the revenue ledger, and makes sure every other agent showed up for work.
All green. If something breaks, it tries to fix it, and alerts me if it can't.
This is one of the agents that runs Autopilot O.I. Free AI guides at the link in bio.
